# braidworks find

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cli_docs.py from `braidworks --help`; do not edit by hand.
     Run `make cli-docs` after changing the command line. -->

Search the installed fields by meaning; use a match with --want or --have. For the task this serves, see the [how-to guides](../../how-to/).

```text
usage: braidworks find WORD… [options]

Search the installed fields by meaning; use a match with --want or --have.

positional arguments:
  WORD                  plain words to search for.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --limit N             most matches to show.
  --format {human,json,tsv}
  --only SOURCES        restrict to these source ids (comma/space separated).

examples:
  braidworks find pdb structures
  braidworks find pathways --format json
  braidworks find organism name --limit 3
```
